page.layout: Running head centred at top with page number at left; title block (heading) at top centre; a woodcut engraving in the middle; a four-line verse stanza below the engraving; catchword at lower right.

main_text.head: TVRPISSIMI MORES extremi aui.
main_text.p: [illegible, ~5 letters]ia, & Sordes, Calumnia, Fœda Voluptas, [illegible, ~4 letters]tus, & officii obliuio, tumq; Rigor: [illegible, ~8 letters]ra extremum teneant cum singula seclum, [illegible, ~1 letter]xtremum Satanæ tibia rauca canit.

page.notes: The engraving shows a horned, winged-headed figure seated atop a globe, playing two trumpets/pipes, with a man in a hat and a second figure with a club on a pedestal of steps; animals (a goat, a pig, a peacock, a dog-like beast, a frog) surround the base, and an oil lamp stands in a basin in front. The verse and the first letters of lines 1–4 are partly rubbed or obscured by the engraving's shadow, so the marked fragments are uncertain. The heading "TVRPISSIMI MORES" is set above "extremi aui." in italic. The catchword "SVMMA" is printed in small capitals at lower right.
